Econsult system is a joke.

At time of making this review I have been trying to see a doctor for 5 months without success. I am not sure there are any doctors there anymore. If there is they are working from home, telephone appointments being flavour of the day. I have telephone appointments with a physio therapist, I'm assuming he can sense how bad the deformation in my right leg is getting by my tone of voice????????

I will never be rude to the staff, they are working in a very challenging situation under difficult circumstances. But the online system is fundamentally broken and is not working, patients have to fill in a crazy amount of text, about drinking, smoking and gambling habits every time they use it making it a very laborious process. Presumably somebody needs to read all this information every time so it certainly is not efficient at their end. The results of the econsultation is often that you need an appointment with a doctor, and to do this you need to start another econsult, and the process loops in
